title: Crosslink sticky contacts and coverage digest
content:
Purpose:
A compact, messy working list for cross-functional on-call/coverage handoffs and a short-run contact digest. Goal is to have one page folks can scan in <2 minutes to find the backup, local-owner, and critical context for weekend/holiday surge coverage. This is intentionally informal — keep it tight.

How to use this doc (quick):
- Whoever is triaging adds/modifies a single row below for their group. 1 line per route/endpoint/coverage area.
- If you become the backup, add a "(backup)" marker next to your name and ping the slo-ops slack thread.
- Leave unresolved questions inline under Notes.

Current snapshot (as-of 2026-05-23):
Columns: Area | Primary owner (local tz) | Backup owner | Coverage window | Ping channel | SLA impact if missing | Quick actions
1) Hosted API - gen endpoints | Evan Martinez (PDT) | Priya Rao (EDT) | 06/05 18:00 - 06/07 06:00 | #hosted-api-ops | High (latency spikes cause client throttles) | Evan: export recent error traces (OPS-1124), Priya: pre-warm canary nodes
2) Dedicated - reserved pools (eu-west) | Marta Kovac (CET) | Tian Wu (CEST) | 06/05 00:00 - 06/07 23:59 | #dedicated-ops | Medium (degraded throughput) | Marta: confirm burst quota; Tian: standby for scale-up script
3) Private deploy customer X | Rajesh Singh (IST) | Asha Patel (PDT) | 06/06 08:00 - 06/06 20:00 | #ps-privates | Critical (customer-facing, contract SLA) | Rajesh: provide handoff notes; Asha: have KMS contacts ready (see linked ticket)
4) Embeddings batch jobs | Priya Rao (EDT) | Vacant (assign) | 06/06 22:00 - 06/07 04:00 | #embeddings | Low (throughput delay only) | Priya: move low-priority batches to off-peak; assign backup - suggested: Monique
5) Rollout - console A/B toggle | Lydia Park (PDT) | Evan Martinez (PDT) | 06/05 12:00 - 06/05 16:00 | #product-console | High (UI rollback impacts many customers) | Lydia: keep canary at 2% until 12:30; Evan: be ready to revert toggle

Notes / Observations:
- Backup gaps: Embeddings has no assigned backup. Recommend Monique or SRE on-call tile to be listed.
- Cross-region fallbacks: We still have older fallback model variants in eu-west that aren't in the routing pool; this has been the root cause of 2 recent customer escalations. Ticket: OPS-1124.
- Cost quick-check: If we scale dedicated pools for weekend surge (estimate +15%), ballpark incremental cost = ~$2.6k/day for eu-west pool (rough calc based on current hourly burn). Confirm with finance if commit increases are permitted for ad-hoc weekend.

Action items (owner / due):
- Assign embeddings backup (Priya) / due 2026-05-23 EOD.
- Export canary latencies for hosted gen endpoints (Evan) / due 2026-05-23 20:00.
- Confirm dedicated burst quota (Marta) / due 2026-05-24 09:00 CET.
- Customer X runbook check-in and KMS contact share (Rajesh + Asha) / due 2026-05-24 12:00 PDT.

Quick checklist for whoever inherits this page:
- Update the single-line entry for your area (do not add multiple rows for same endpoint).
- If you escalate, add the escalation Slack thread link to that row.
- Mark "resolved" next to action items once done.

Unresolved questions (short):
- Do we want a temporary weekend override to increase canary traffic from 2% to 5% for the console toggle? (Lydia)
- Is finance OK with short-term dedicated pool burst above current commit? (Marta / Finance)
- Who is the official on-call for embeddings this weekend? (ops)

Background links and quick refs:
- CONFLUENCE: coverage-runbook-2026 (full weekend runbook)
- JIRA: OPS-1124 (routing fallback investigation)
- Slack: #hosted-api-ops (live incident channel)

Scratch / quick logs:
- 2026-05-22 16:12 PDT: noticed small uptick in gen endpoint 95th p99 latency (approx +55ms over baseline) - Evan to investigate traces.
- 2026-05-22 19:00 CET: Dedicated pool in eu-west reported queue-length spikes during scheduled batch window. Marta created temp autoscale increase.

Footer / provenance:
- Created by Asha Patel during rapid ops pre-flight, 2026-05-23.
- Maintainers: company-ops on-call rotation. Keep this doc short; if it grows beyond 1 screen, move to the full coverage runbook and link back.

-- end --
